Physical_Environment.Location: Tsinghua University, Department of Psychology, Beijing, China (laboratory rooms; participants tested individually in dimly lit room)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (matching: matching, nonmatching) × 3 (identity: self, friend, stranger) × 4 (emotion: control, neutral, happy, sad) × 6 (block) × 2 (group: control, subclinical depression), mixed design; group between-subjects, matching/identity/emotion/block within-subjects

Block_Structure.Trial_number: 36 trials per TrialList cycle ; multiple cycles per block

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: simultaneous (shape with emotion expression and label displayed together)

Stimulus_Properties.Modality: Visual (circular shapes with emotional expressions + Chinese labels)
Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Three base circle types (c, hc, vc) × 4 emotions (control, happy, neutral, sad) = 12 shape-emotion combinations: c.bmp, c_eh.bmp, c_en.bmp, c_es.bmp, hc.bmp, hc_eh.bmp, hc_en.bmp, hc_es.bmp, vc.bmp, vc_eh.bmp, vc_en.bmp, vc_es.bmp
Stimulus_Properties.Label: 自己 (self), 朋友 (friend), 生人 (stranger)

exp2.detail: Experiment 2 (Task2) of Hu et al. (2015). Same 36 participants as Exp1 (30 control low BDI, 6 subclinical depression high BDI; 3 excluded: 6008, 6015, 6031). IRB approved by Tsinghua University Psychology Department. E-Prime 2.0, 1024×768, 100 Hz, dimly lit room. Mixed design: 2 (matching/nonmatching) × 3 (identity: self, friend, stranger) × 4 (emotion: control, neutral, happy, sad) × 6 (blocks) × 2 (group: control/depression). Participants learn to associate three distinct circle types (c, hc, vc) with self, friend, stranger; each circle type appears with 4 emotional expressions. 6 sessions (Session 1-6 per codebook), 6 formal blocks (BlockList.Sample 1-6). Each block contains multiple TrialList cycles of 36 trials (TrialList.Cycle sequences: 2-6, 8-12, 14-18, 20-24, 26-30, 32-36). Practice trials have BlockList.Sample=NA. ITI 1000 ms, Target.OnsetDelay 10 ms. Stimuli: 12 circle-emotion images (3 identities × 4 emotions). Labels: 自己(self), 朋友(friend), 生人(stranger) with English translations self, friend, stranger. Selfpic and Stranger picture assignments (c, hc, vc) counterbalanced per participant. Response keys: m, n (Target.CRESP, Target.RESP). Data collected Oct-Dec 2015. Standardized to SPE Database schema v2 on 2026-09-25: per-participant files merged into a single trial-level CSV; column order aligned to the v2 template; Matching canonicalized to Matching/Nonmatching; identity columns canonicalized (Self/Close/Stranger); a between-subjects Group column added; study-specific columns moved to the tail. Source: clean/ (read-only). 2026-09-25: the Clean CSV exceeded 50 MB and was split at whole-subject boundaries (SKILL.md 'large-file split' rule) into Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Exp2_Clean_part1.csv (19 subjects, 167,681 rows, 31.4 MB, subjects 6001-6019) and Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Exp2_Clean_part2.csv (17 subjects, 151,632 rows, 28.5 MB, subjects 6020-6036); both parts share this JSON, the single subj_info and the single codebook, and rbind(part1, part2) restores the original file byte-for-byte.
